### Peace . . . in Spite of Panic
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/peace-.-.-.-in-spite-of-panic
Passage: Isaiah 26:3-4
Points:
- Genuine inner peace is one of the rarest yet most pursued virtues in human life.
- The Hebrew concept of a steadfast mind describes a mindset sustained by leaning fully upon God.
- Biblical "perfect peace" represents an unending calm and security guarded by the Lord.
- Trusting God requires abandoning personal crutches and placing all our anxieties upon Him.
- Because the Lord is an eternal rock, He provides an unshakable foundation through stressful times.

### God, the Peacekeeper
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/god-the-peacekeeper
Passage: Isaiah 26:3
Points:
- Human self-awareness becomes destructive when it turns into self-worship and self-centered living.
- Focusing constantly on oneself and personal anxieties crowds out God's peace.
- True happiness and calm are discovered when we deny self and follow Christ.
- Turning our thoughts often to the Lord allows Him to keep us in perfect peace.

### Finding Peace When Your Plans Suddenly Change
Author: Lyli Dunbar
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/finding-peace-when-your-plans-suddenly-change.html
Passage: Isaiah 26:3
Points:
- Unexpected disruptions to our plans easily produce anxiety, sleeplessness, and frustration.
- Striving in our own strength to figure out and fix every obstacle displaces peace with chaos.
- Shifting attention away from circumstances toward God's character unlocks His promised wholeness.
- Rehearsing God's power, goodness, and eternal control enables us to surrender tomorrow into His care.

### Resting Secure in the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/resting-secure-in-the-lord
Passage: Isaiah 26:1-4
Points:
- The safety of God's people rests entirely on His sovereign power rather than human defenses.
- Christians often experience persistent fear when they try to maintain their salvation by their own efforts.
- Sanctification and ultimate preservation are secured by God's grace and faithfulness alone.
- Deliverance from sin and enduring peace are found only by leaning wholly on Jesus Christ.
